metadata.title: Rigidity of nonsteady gradient Kähler-Ricci solitons with constant scalar curvature
authors: Matheus Andrade Ribeiro de Moura Horácio
metadata.abstract: We prove that every complete nonsteady gradient Kähler-Ricci soliton with constant scalar curvature is rigid. This establishes Cao's rigidity conjecture for Kähler-Ricci solitons in arbitrary dimension and gives the corresponding result for expanding solitons, without additional curvature assumptions. The proof uses a rigidity criterion for gradient Ricci solitons with constant scalar curvature, expressed by the vanishing of the Lie derivative of the Ricci tensor along the soliton vector field. In the Kähler case, this vanishing follows from constant scalar curvature, the closedness of the Ricci form, and the classical real holomorphicity of the soliton vector field.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.progressType: 常标量曲率 Kähler–Ricci 孤立子的刚性
analysis.workSummary: 由 Ricci 形式闭性和孤立子向量场实全纯性得到 L∇f Ric=0，再以 Ricci 幂迹递推推出 Ric²=λRic，应用既有刚性定理将普遍覆叠分解为 Kähler–Einstein 因子与复 Euclidean 因子。
analysis.breakthrough: 以沿孤立子向量场的 Ricci 不变性建立相应 Cao 刚性猜想的结论。
analysis.limitations: λ≠0、完整、梯度 Kähler 及标量曲率恒定均需保留；所得一般流形是乘积的离散群商，不必本身全局直积。
